title: Import lookup matcher never tries the target object's unique fields (an autonumber included)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27434 said: triage rows 1–7, TAKE what is ui-only, CARD the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `e41642dd` (report 6515174308, `out_of_scope_findings`).
Reach: Data import of a file whose lookup cells name the target by an autonumber or another unique field ("ACC-000012"), such as any old export file after a record title changed.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/core`).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "import resolveRef lookup match by unique field autonumber reference_not_found" → #24981 (closed; it added the title field), nothing open.

## Observed
`resolveRef` in `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts` tries the id, the lookup's `displayField`, the target's title field, then name / title / label / full_name / email / username, and stops. A cell holding the target's autonumber or another unique field names nothing and reports `reference_not_found`. Any title change breaks every old export file. The candidate list is unchanged on `e41642dd`.

## Wanted
Before reporting `reference_not_found`, also try the target's fields declared `unique` (an autonumber included), keeping the existing ambiguity rule. Tests beside `resolveRef`.

Dedupe words: import resolve by unique field, resolveRef autonumber, reference_not_found unique, import lookup matcher.

Related: #27434 (row 6), #24981.
